grammar_focus: KS7/31/55 一般过去 vs 过去进行 vs used to/would(教材 L79 Key structures,方案B换情节包):一般过去时讲发生的事(stopped/cleared/arrived/opened)、过去进行时讲当时正发生的背景(were traveling/was raining/was waiting/was sleeping)、used to / would 讲过去的习惯(used to take/would always sit/would tell),以及三者在叙事中的配合
scene: 我小时候,一家人每年夏天都坐火车去外婆家。我们总是坐在窗边,看着田野掠过。有一年,我们往北走的途中,火车突然停了。当时雨下得很大,前方一棵树倒在了铁轨上。大家安静地等着,工人们把树清走。我弟弟在睡觉,我却看着雨水顺着玻璃往下流。从前,爸爸总会给我们讲故事打发时间。那天,他聊起了他小时候常坐的那些旅行。几个小时后,火车又开动了,我们终于在夜里到了。我至今还记得,外婆开门时那张多么开心的脸。

grammar_card.title: KS7/31/55 一般过去 / 过去进行 / used to·would
grammar_card.intro: 讲过去的故事,三种说法配合用:①一般过去时——一件件“发生了”的事(the train stopped / we arrived);②过去进行时——某时“正在发生”的背景(while we were traveling / it was raining);③used to / would——过去“习惯性、反复”做的事(my family used to take the train / we would always sit by the window)。used to 强调“过去常、现在不再”;would 强调“过去反复的动作”(不用于状态)。

rows: The train suddenly stopped. / We arrived at night.
过去进行(正发生的背景)
While we were traveling north… / It was raining hard.
My family used to take the train every summer.
We would always sit by the window.
While we were traveling, the train stopped; dad would tell stories.

specialRules.rule: 美语里“铁路”说 railroad(英式 railway)、“秋天”说 fall(英式 autumn)、“假期”说 vacation(英式 holiday);本课已按美语写。
used to + 动词原形=过去常做(现在不再);would + 动词原形=过去反复的动作。二者都讲过去习惯,但 would 不用于“状态”(说 There used to be…,不说 There would be…)。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why did the train stop that year?
options: A tree had fallen across the track

passage: When I was a child, my family used to take the train to my grandma's every summer. We would always sit by the window and watch the fields go by. One year, while we were traveling north, the train suddenly stopped. It was raining hard, and a tree had fallen across the track ahead. Everyone was waiting quietly while the workers cleared it away. My little brother was sleeping, but I watched the rain run down the glass. In the old days, my dad would tell us stories to pass the time. That day he told us about the trips he used to take as a boy. Hours later, the train started again, and we finally arrived at night. I still remember how happy grandma looked when she opened the door.
